    Mesh data of the lifted modules (toward Corollary 12.1) #

    The lifted mesh sequences 0 → M_{τx}^B → ⊕_a M_{y_a}^B → M_x^B → 0 are exact sequences of right B-modules (LiftedMesh.lean); applying Hom_B(M_w^B, −) and Hom_B(−, M_w^B) gives the exactness required of a MeshData on the lifted modules (meshB), with the radical of localB (filtration order at least one).
